scope: Investigate food consumed without the cat walking to the bowl; improve route completeness and preserve feeding through care-control updates.

findings.status: confirmed core defect, not conclusively matched to the physical session
findings.detail: At a narrow floor passage, 12 nearest visible endpoint connectors can omit an existing safe return path after a permitted stroll. Reduced 420x640 geometry reproduces this; the new regression fails on build 7 and passes with the repair.

findings.status: layout instability confirmed by SwiftUI probe; interruption is a possible ordering race
findings.detail: Removing the food-cost subtitle when inventory reaches zero can change the care row height by 7 points, and same-value SpriteKit size assignment invokes didChangeSize. Both can reset the presentation. The baseline build 7 last-food UI test on SE passed, so an iOS cancellation was not reproduced in that run.
The user explicitly confirmed Reduce Motion is disabled. It is not an explanation for the reported physical behavior.

Keep the food-cost subtitle in layout with transparent/AX-hidden empty-stock presentation and fix button-content height at 45 points.
Avoid assigning identical scene sizes on appearance and ignore same-size didChangeSize callbacks.
